restaurantName: Vent Debout - Hôtel Les Hautes Mers
bio: Just imagine: the Île d'Yeu, a pretty little hotel overlooking the sea, a chic, laid-back restaurant, a terrace and a dining area decorated with models of old sailing ships... All in all, a truly charming spot for food lovers who can expect a deliciously fishy regional menu....
pageTitle: Vent Debout - Hôtel Les Hautes Mers
